name: discord_modify_member
description: Modify a guild member. Provide `guild_id`, `user_id`, and any of: `nick` (nickname), `roles` (array of role ID strings — REPLACES the member's full role set), `mute`/`deaf` (voice), `channel_id` (move to a voice channel), `communication_disabled_until` (ISO-8601 timestamp to time the member out; must be <=28 days ahead, or null/empty to clear). Requires the matching permission per field.

roles.description: Full replacement set of role IDs the member should have.

channel_id.description: Voice channel ID to move the member into.

communication_disabled_until.description: ISO-8601 timestamp until which the member is timed out (max 28 days out). Pass null/empty to remove the timeout.
